name: @local/dsh-oks
description: A Harness capability, not a wrapper for one model: whatever knowledge service (OKS) and data file a session's workspace declares in oks.json become five native tools — search / references / info / check_intent / query — turning a business question into rows read from that data file over a read-only connection. Search finds the keys of the vocabulary by name or description, references walks the reference graph backwards, and oks_info reads any node from the opaque key "index".
